rationale: BLOCKED. I read the complete held EO 7794 (3 FR 225, Jan. 20, 1938, official PDF recheck text): it corrects the metes-and-bounds description of Parcel One in EO 6050 of Feb. 27, 1933 (two parcels in the Tongass National Forest near Juneau assigned to the Secretary of War for an Army radio receiving station), 74.30 acres. It has no own term and no savings clause. The catalog note says only 'Amends: EO 605, February 27, 1933' (EO 6050 mis-numbered in the note; the order's own text says No. 6050). It is a correction whose effect lives in EO 6050; whether the site was later revoked, restored to the Forest Service or transferred (a common fate of such withdrawals) is not in any held source. The text is a pdfplumber reading of a scan and contains recognition errors in the metes and bounds, so exact boundary conclusions would also need the page image. I decline both statuses.
